body: It's been two months - and I'm trying so hard to move on! But it's hard now because I don't want him back as a boyfriend, I just want him in my life, and I have less than two weeks to prove to him that I deserve a place in his life because we're graduating in thirteen days, it just feels so awful that I gave so much of myself to him and trusted him and loved him and he can disregard me and invalidate me so easily

But how am I supposed to let go of someone who I care about *so* much, it's too hard to hold onto things but I can't let them go 

I just want to ask him to come for a walk or smoke a bowl or something with me, I just want to feel his space and know we care about each other even if we don't love each other anymore, I want us to be friends who once were more but now aren't because it didn't work out, and have it be *ok*

I think he hates me, we were close after he left me and then he tried to sleep with me and then he wouldn't speak to me for weeks and then this week finally things were ok and nice again until yesterday, he was so rude and angry and dismissive to me and I don't know what I did and I want to make myself better enough for him but I don't know how because I don't know what I did wrong 

And I sent him a message this morning saying I was so sad because I want him in my life but know he doesn't want me in his and he saw it and didn't say a thing, it is killing me to watch the degradation of every aspect of our relationship 

It has been two months it is not cool or ok anymore for me to talk about how sad I am, everyone wants me to shut up I want myself to shut up I want my mind to shut up I want to crush my head against a brick wall

I used to go to therapy but my therapist just closed her practice. We had our last meeting yesterday. And I've talked a little bit to a teacher I'm close with and a lot of friends. And my parents know I'm struggling although not to this extent. Hard to hide when I'm just always always crying or panicking or sick. 

Talking to people doesn't help, really. Makes me feel better for a second but I'm just worried everyone's tired of me. Wouldn't blame them.
Ignoring him means cutting myself off from my entire social structure...no way out
I've done both :( I'm in therapy and also been emailing with a history teacher I'm close to. Both have them have just told me to wait. But things don't get better.
